gate_type: D-DAY TRACK B — CAPPER HERO + COMPRESSOR SECONDARY SCENARIOS
objective: Implement the already-frozen B1 hero scenario BW-CAP-DEG-01 for BW-FP-CAP01 as a small deterministic causal abnormal scenario: NORMAL → DEGRADING → WARNING → INTERMITTENT_STOP → RECOVERY. Also implement a simpler secondary compressor utility scenario BW-CMP-SAG-01 for BW-UT-CMP01: NORMAL → PRESSURE_SAG → RECOVERY. Capper remains the hero production-impact story. Compressor is a bounded air-pressure excursion with one alarm pair and no production inhibit / no downtime. Both are deterministic, independently testable, and non-overlapping in the default demo story. Do not simulate KPI values. Manual downtime/failure classification may only enrich an already-existing Capper event.

conservative_interpretation.issue_107_live_read: The live Issue #107 body could not be re-fetched in this run (GitHub App token has no issues:read; GraphQL unresolved / REST 403). The original #107 Capper contract was already implemented at a1e0a30. The 2026-10-04 SA instruction explicitly added a Compressor scenario update and required: Capper = hero abnormal; Compressor = simpler secondary utility; both deterministic; independently testable; non-overlapping in the default demo story.
conservative_interpretation.non_overlap: Default compressor NORMAL duration is 240 s simulated. Capper abnormal window is 102–210 s (DEGRADING through RECOVERY). Compressor PRESSURE_SAG therefore starts after the Capper story has finished.
conservative_interpretation.independence: Each helper can be disabled at factory construction. Tests may inject a short-duration compressor config and disable Capper, and vice versa.
conservative_interpretation.no_generic_framework: Compressor is a sibling workspace helper, not a shared scenario engine.
conservative_interpretation.b1_frozen: workspace.contract.yaml and capper_degradation.contract.yaml stay Capper-authoritative. Compressor contract lives beside them under scenarios/ as a B5 addition.
